tools.description: Call this, and say nothing at all, when what you just heard was not said to you: people talking to each other, someone on a call or reading aloud, a television, a noise. It is how you stay out of a conversation that is not yours.
tools.name: not_for_me

tools.description: Call this whenever you need the time or the date now: when someone asks what time it is, what day it is, or how long until something. The time you were told when you woke may be hours old; this one is exact. Then say it as it gives it "said aloud", with its hour. Not for "now" or "today" in a question about something else, such as how you are feeling right now, and never say the time unless you were asked for it.
tools.name: the_time

tools.description: Call this when someone asks you to remember something or keep it in mind for later. Give what to keep as one short sentence that will still make sense weeks from now, with their own words for names and numbers. Then say back in a few words what you kept, so they can put you right if you misheard.
tools.name: remember

text.description: What to keep, in one short sentence.

tools.description: Call this when someone asks about something from an earlier conversation or an earlier day that you do not already know: what they told you, what you talked about yesterday, something they asked you to remember. Not for what was said in this conversation. If nothing is found, say you do not remember; never make something up. You cannot tell who is speaking now, so do not say 'you told me': just give what you remember, roughly and without dates or times.
tools.name: recall

about.description: One to four key words to look for, such as 'coffee' or 'dentist appointment'. Leave out for the most recent conversations.

days_ago.description: Only that day: 0 for today, 1 for yesterday. Leave out for any day.

tools.description: Call this when someone asks you to forget the last thing they asked you to remember. Then tell them briefly that it is off your list, and do not use it again.
tools.name: forget

tools.description: Make your own speaker louder by one step, when someone asks you to speak up or says you are too quiet.
tools.name: volume_up

tools.description: Make your own speaker quieter, when someone asks you to keep it down or says you are too loud.
tools.name: volume_down

tools.description: Silence your own speaker until you are asked to unmute it.
tools.name: volume_mute

tools.description: Bring your own speaker back after it was muted.
tools.name: volume_unmute

tools.description: Switch your own light on, when someone asks for light and names no colour.
tools.name: light_on

tools.description: Set your own light to one of the named colours. Violet is purple; warm white is warm.
tools.name: light_colour

tools.description: Make your own light a step brighter, keeping its colour.
tools.name: light_brighter

tools.description: Make your own light a step dimmer, keeping its colour, when someone says it is too bright or harsh.
tools.name: light_dimmer
